evaluation_design.interpretation: Latest-vintage historical forecast exercise, not real-time or causal evidence
evaluation_design.model_selection: none; AR lag order fixed at one before evaluation
evaluation_design.training: expanding window, observations through target year minus one only

independent_data_check: Every scaled level compared with a direct extraction of the authenticated raw JSON

meta.description: Gross domestic product at market prices (constant prices)
meta.label: GDP (constant LCU)
meta.sa: NSA, annual (calendar or fiscal year, see wdi_meta)
meta.units: millions of constant LCU, country base year

panel_attrs.splice_policy: One WDI indicator; no provider splicing or gap filling
panel_attrs.vintage_semantics: Latest revised WDI edition captured at fetched_at; not historical information sets

source.name: World Bank World Development Indicators (source 2)
source.units: millions of constant LCU, country-specific base/reference year

transformations: Raw constant-LCU levels divided by 1,000,000 by wdi_panel

No interpolation, seasonal adjustment, cross-country level comparison, or source splicing
